title: Real app actions through the model, then inside its architecture
kind: Actual local browser interaction; manual fixture actors

video.editing: H.264 transcode only; no time compression, injected overlays, slideshows or substituted UI

poster.source: Frame extracted from the published MP4 at 61 seconds

source.note: The baseline commit alone does not identify the working tree. The implementation/template hashes and build subject identify the recorded implementation.

tools.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.0.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers
tools.harness: Existing PlayIDE Take/Scene and ephemeral_eija_server; isolated workspace, normal CSP

steps: RefundDesk: a model beside its local application
Build passes its conformance checks; source-review gate stays visible
Create one synthetic record in the real local database
Assess: the committed action arrives at Assessed
Propose: the next committed action reaches AwaitingApproval
Pause the trace to inspect; the application remains live
Manually fire the clock fixture; its real commit queues for inspection
Inspect the actor, committed state, version, effects and build identity
Replay three recorded outcomes; no extra requests or database changes
Payment fixture reports failure; no external payment is attempted
Payment fixture reports settlement; no money moves
C4: explore the architecture generated for this exact app
Browser, local server and SQLite: responsibilities are visible
Follow the server's relationship to the same runtime kernel
Return to the unchanged local result and its recorded actions

inspection.method: 13 video-derived timeline frames, full-resolution ending extracted from MP4, full-resolution action/C4 screenshots and complete MP4 decode
inspection.notes: Actual app commits, visible arrivals, paused inspection, recorded replay and three native C4 levels are readable. Refined final interaction scrolls naturally to visible Paid state, result and history beside the arrival marker. Source-review and fixture labels remain visible. No credentials or private launch URLs appear. Native panels scroll; the video does not claim all graph/details are simultaneously visible.

limitations: C4 is generated structural evidence; it does not establish runtime flow or deployment.
Manual clock and payment fixture actors; no elapsed timer, money movement or external delivery.
Local trace observations are not a complete runtime history.
This scoped demonstration is not full milestone acceptance or human usability evidence.

evidence.location: Originating local capture workspace; excluded from public package because it is machine-specific.
